---
title: "Analyzing School District Reading Scores"
Author: "Mariana Comartin"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), "data/seda_2025.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)
dbplyr_dist <- tbl(con, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
#| message: false
district_2015 <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, rla_2015 = rla_score)
district_2023 <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, rla_2023 = rla_score)
score_change <- inner_join(
  district_2015,
  district_2023,
  by = c("district_id", "district_name", "state")
) |>
  mutate(rla_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, rla_change) |>
  collect()
state_scores <- tbl(con, "state_scores")
state_2015 <- state_scores |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, rla_2015 = rla_score)
state_2023 <- state_scores |>
  filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, rla_2023 = rla_score)
state_change <- inner_join(
  state_2015,
  state_2023,
  by = c("stateabb", "state_name")
) |>
  mutate(score_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, rla_2015, rla_2023, score_change) |>
  arrange(stateabb) |>
  collect()
print(state_change, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
ggplot(score_change, aes(x = rla_change, fill = rla_change > 0)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "steelblue", "TRUE" = "tomato"),
    labels = c("FALSE" = "Negative or no change", "TRUE" = "Positive"),
    name = "Score change"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Change in District Reading Scores",
    subtitle = paste("Districts with data in both years (n =", nrow(score_change), ")"),
    x = "Reading score change (2023 minus 2015)",
    y = "Number of districts",
    caption = "Positive values indicate improvement; dashed line marks no change."
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 12
state_plot <- state_change |>
  arrange(rla_2023) |>
  mutate(
    state_name = factor(state_name, levels = state_name),
    direction = if_else(score_change > 0, "Improvement", "Decline or no change")
  )

ggplot(state_plot, aes(y = state_name)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = rla_2015, xend = rla_2023, yend = state_name, color = direction),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "inches"), type = "closed"),
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = rla_2015), color = "gray50", size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Improvement" = "tomato", "Decline or no change" = "steelblue"),
    name = "Change"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "State Reading Scores: 2015 to 2023",
    subtitle = "States are ordered by their 2023 reading score",
    x = "Reading score",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Arrows run from 2015 to 2023; gray dots mark 2015 scores."
  )
```
